d: Building an extraordinary custom chopper takes more than a creative design. It demands engineering skills, precision, patience and plenty of hard work. Step inside the Orange County Choppers workshop as Paul Sr., Paul Jr. and the crew take on ambitious motorcycle projects, work through fabrication challenges and bring unique designs to life. Get a closer look at the craftsmanship and effort behind every custom motorcycle. Watch American Chopper Season 5 Episodes 18, 2, 20, 3, 4, 5 and 9 only on discovery+ India.
